# Itay Shechter (איתי שכטר)

> Social Media Lead. Works where news, creativity and audience meet: from an idea to content people actually want to watch, share and respond to. Founding team member and head of social at V1, an Israeli news app.

- Built V1's social presence from zero: 300K+ followers across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, organic growth (100K+ on Instagram in under a year).
- Previously: TikTok content manager at Fresh Agency (Samsung, KFC, Papa John's, BUYME, Cellcom), social media manager at HOT, researcher at Kan 11 digital (the "Od Yom" podcast).
- Builds internal tools with AI (Claude): for example, an Instagram stories tracker on the Meta API and Google Sheets.
- B.A. in Communications, the College of Management.
